2609.24586.title: Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation
2609.24586.paper_summary: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series prediction.
2609.24586.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的評估指標提供數值，但往往缺乏可理解性，妨礙了模型性能的有效區分。<lb/>我們的工作通過引入 overlay\_dx 來解決這一挑戰，這是一種新穎的評估指標，用於測量時間序列預測模型的性能。<lb/>Overlay\_dx 是一種視覺指標，表示預測值落在實際值周圍的置信區間內的百分比。<lb/>此外，一旦評估結果被繪製，overlay\_dx 會計算覆蓋曲線下的面積，提供預測值與實際值在不同閾值和預測下的對齊程度的量化測量。<lb/>通過廣泛的實驗，我們證明了我們的方法提供了一個統一的評估框架，結合了視覺和數值評估，從而改善模型比較並為時間序列預測的進一步研究和優化工作提供有價值的見解。
